senses.en: Dark, glassy volcanic rock.

ex.en: Early people made sharp blades from obsidian.
ex.zh: 早期人类用黑曜石制作锋利的刀片。

senses.en: a person's usual mood and way of behaving
a natural tendency or willingness to do something
the arrangement of people or things in particular positions

ex.en: Her cheerful disposition makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨天的早晨也显得明亮起来。

ex.en: Children with a cautious disposition may benefit from gradual exposure to unfamiliar classroom activities.
ex.zh: 性格谨慎的孩子逐步接触陌生的课堂活动，可能会从中受益。

col: a disposition to help｜乐于助人的倾向
a disposition towards anxiety｜容易焦虑的倾向
tip: 性情义常用单数；a disposition to do表示做某事的倾向。

senses.en: A light volcanic rock full of holes that can float on water.

ex.en: Pumice floated on the sea after the eruption.
ex.zh: 喷发后浮石漂浮在海面上。

senses.en: A gray volcanic rock common in mountain ranges.

ex.en: The Andes give their name to andesite.
ex.zh: 安山岩得名于安第斯山脉。

senses.en: A pale volcanic rock rich in silica.

ex.en: Rhyolite eruptions are often very explosive.
ex.zh: 流纹岩喷发往往非常猛烈。

senses.en: Rock made of sand grains pressed together.

ex.en: The red sandstone cliffs glowed at sunset.
ex.zh: 红色砂岩悬崖在夕阳下闪耀。

senses.en: To produce a particular result, especially credit or benefit.

ex.en: Your generosity will redound to the whole team's credit.
ex.zh: 你的慷慨之举将为整个团队增光。

ex.en: Sustained investment in public libraries can redound to the benefit of communities by expanding access to knowledge.
ex.zh: 持续投资公共图书馆可以扩大获取知识的机会，从而造福社区。

col: redound to someone's credit｜为某人增光
redound to the benefit of｜有益于
redound to someone's honour｜为某人增添荣誉
tip: 正式且少见；常接to，不能直接接宾语表示增加。

senses.en: Soft rock that splits easily into thin layers.

ex.en: Natural gas is trapped in shale.
ex.zh: 天然气被封存在页岩中。

senses.en: Fine-grained rock formed from hardened mud.

ex.en: Dinosaur tracks were preserved in mudstone.
ex.zh: 恐龙足迹保存在泥岩中。

senses.en: Rock made of sharp broken fragments cemented together.

ex.en: Breccia forms near faults and craters.
ex.zh: 角砾岩形成于断层和陨石坑附近。

senses.en: Dark gray rock that splits into thin flat pieces.

ex.en: The roof was covered with slate tiles.
ex.zh: 屋顶铺着石板瓦。

senses.en: An official finding that someone is not guilty or responsible.

ex.en: Her exoneration brought relief to the whole family.
ex.zh: 她获证清白，让全家都松了一口气。

ex.en: The exoneration of wrongly convicted individuals demonstrates why legal systems must allow new evidence to be reviewed.
ex.zh: 被错误定罪者获证清白，说明司法体系必须允许重新审查新证据。

col: lead to exoneration｜使人获证清白
tip: 强调证明无罪或无责；pardon指赦免。

senses.en: Very hard rock formed from sandstone under heat and pressure.

ex.en: Quartzite resists weathering.
ex.zh: 石英岩耐风化。

senses.en: Metamorphic rock that splits into thin, shiny layers.

ex.en: Mica flakes make schist sparkle.
ex.zh: 云母片使片岩闪闪发光。

senses.en: Metamorphic rock with light and dark bands.

ex.en: Some of the oldest rocks on Earth are gneiss.
ex.zh: 地球上最古老的一些岩石是片麻岩。

senses.en: The most common group of minerals in the earth's crust.

ex.en: Feldspar weathers into clay.
ex.zh: 长石风化成黏土。

senses.en: To read or examine something carefully

ex.en: Please peruse the rental agreement before you sign it.
ex.zh: 签字前请仔细阅读租赁协议。

ex.en: Students should peruse the assessment criteria carefully before preparing their final research projects for submission.
ex.zh: 学生在准备提交最终研究项目之前，应仔细阅读评分标准。

col: peruse a report｜仔细阅读报告
tip: 正式用词；直接接阅读对象，名词为perusal。

senses.en: A mineral that splits into thin, shiny, transparent sheets.

ex.en: Mica was once used in stove windows.
ex.zh: 云母曾被用于炉窗。

senses.en: A common mineral made of calcium carbonate.

ex.en: Limestone is made mostly of calcite.
ex.zh: 石灰岩主要由方解石构成。

senses.en: A soft white mineral used to make plaster.

ex.en: Gypsum forms when salty water evaporates.
ex.zh: 咸水蒸发时会形成石膏。

senses.en: The mineral form of common salt.

ex.en: Thick beds of halite lie beneath the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠下方有厚厚的岩盐层。

senses.en: Made of crystals; very clear.

ex.en: Granite has a crystalline structure.
ex.zh: 花岗岩具有结晶结构。

senses.en: a shiny yellow mineral containing iron and sulphur

ex.en: The tiny piece of pyrite glittered in her palm.
ex.zh: 那小块黄铁矿在她掌心闪闪发亮。

ex.en: Although pyrite resembles gold, its chemical composition and commercial value are very different from those of gold.
ex.zh: 虽然黄铁矿看似黄金，但其化学成分和商业价值与黄金大不相同。

tip: 因外观似金，俗称 fool’s gold（愚人金）。

senses.en: A regular repeated pattern, as of atoms in a crystal or crossed strips.

ex.en: Atoms in salt form a cubic lattice.
ex.zh: 盐中的原子构成立方晶格。

senses.en: The way a mineral splits along flat surfaces; a division.

ex.en: Mica has perfect cleavage in one direction.
ex.zh: 云母在一个方向上有完全解理。

senses.en: The way a surface shines when light falls on it.

ex.en: Gold has a metallic luster.
ex.zh: 金子有金属光泽。

senses.en: A layer of rock; a level of society.

ex.en: Each stratum represents a different period.
ex.zh: 每个地层代表不同的时期。

senses.en: a general feeling of illness or unease without a clear cause
a widespread lack of confidence, energy, or progress in society

ex.en: A lingering malaise kept me on the sofa all afternoon.
ex.zh: 持续的不适让我整个下午都待在沙发上。

ex.en: Prolonged economic malaise can weaken public confidence and discourage businesses from investing in new projects.
ex.zh: 长期的经济低迷会削弱公众信心，并使企业不愿投资新项目。

col: a sense of malaise｜一种不安感
tip: 较正式，既指笼统的身体不适，也可指社会经济低迷。

senses.en: The study of rock layers and their order.

ex.en: Stratigraphy helps date fossils.
ex.zh: 地层学有助于确定化石的年代。

senses.en: Solid rock beneath soil; the basic principles on which something rests.

ex.en: The building's foundations rest on bedrock.
ex.zh: 建筑地基坐落在基岩上。

senses.en: An arch-shaped fold in rock layers.

ex.en: Oil often collects in an anticline.
ex.zh: 石油常聚集在背斜中。

senses.en: A trough-shaped fold in rock layers.

ex.en: The valley follows a syncline.
ex.zh: 这条山谷沿着一个向斜延伸。

senses.en: to place things among others at intervals

ex.en: She interspersed bright flowers among the herbs on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台的香草植物之间点缀了鲜艳的花朵。

ex.en: Teachers can intersperse short discussions throughout lectures to maintain attention and encourage students to participate.
ex.zh: 教师可以在讲课过程中穿插简短讨论，以保持学生的注意力并鼓励参与。

col: intersperse A with B｜在A中穿插B
tip: intersperse A with B：在A中穿插B。

senses.en: The gradual sinking of land.

ex.en: Pumping groundwater caused subsidence.
ex.zh: 抽取地下水导致地面沉降。

senses.en: The laying down of sediment by water, wind or ice; removing someone from power.

ex.en: Deposition at the river mouth built a delta.
ex.zh: 河口的沉积形成了三角洲。

senses.en: Sand, silt and clay left by flowing water.

ex.en: Fertile alluvium covers the valley floor.
ex.zh: 肥沃的冲积土覆盖着谷底。

senses.en: A bend in a river; to follow a winding course.

ex.en: The river meanders across the plain.
ex.zh: 河流蜿蜒流过平原。

senses.zh: 全套用具；杂七杂八的物品
senses.en: The various objects needed for a particular activity.

ex.en: Our camping paraphernalia filled every corner of the garage.
ex.zh: 我们的露营用具塞满了车库的每个角落。

ex.en: Schools need adequate storage for sports paraphernalia to keep shared spaces safe and equipment accessible to students.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的空间存放体育用具，以确保公共区域安全，并方便学生取用器材。

col: all the paraphernalia｜全套杂项用具
tip: 通常作不可数名词，不加a，也不再加复数s。

senses.en: A U-shaped bend in a river, or a lake formed when it is cut off.

ex.en: An oxbow lake formed after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后形成了一个牛轭湖。

senses.en: Flat land next to a river that floods regularly.

ex.en: Farms on the floodplain have rich soil.
ex.zh: 河漫滩上的农场土壤肥沃。

senses.en: A raised bank built along a river to prevent flooding.

ex.en: The levee broke during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中堤坝决口了。

senses.en: The place where two rivers meet; a coming together.

ex.en: The city stands at the confluence of two rivers.
ex.zh: 这座城市位于两河交汇处。

senses.en: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides.

ex.en: A stream runs through the ravine.
ex.zh: 一条小溪流过峡谷。

senses.en: A simple organism that photosynthesises, usually living in water.

ex.en: Under the microscope, the tiny green alga looked beautiful.
ex.zh: 在显微镜下，这个微小的绿藻显得很美。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating whether this freshwater alga can remove pollutants from wastewater while producing material suitable for biofuel.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探索这种淡水藻能否在去除废水污染物的同时，产生适合制造生物燃料的原料。

tip: alga是单数，复数为algae；整体谈藻类常用复数。

senses.en: Relating to glaciers or ice ages; very cold or slow.

ex.en: Glacial ice carved the valley.
ex.zh: 冰川冰雕刻出了这条山谷。

senses.en: The covering of land by glaciers, or the effects of it.

ex.en: Repeated glaciation shaped the Great Lakes.
ex.zh: 反复的冰川作用塑造了五大湖。

senses.en: A ridge of rocks and soil left by a glacier.

ex.en: The moraine marks where the glacier ended.
ex.zh: 冰碛标志着冰川的尽头。

senses.en: A long oval hill shaped by a glacier.

ex.en: Drumlins point in the direction the ice moved.
ex.zh: 鼓丘指向冰川移动的方向。

senses.en: a soft black form of carbon

ex.en: Pencil lead is actually graphite.
ex.zh: 铅笔芯其实是石墨。

ex.en: Graphite and diamond are both made of carbon, yet their atoms are arranged in completely different ways.
ex.zh: 石墨和金刚石都由碳构成，但原子排列方式完全不同。

senses.en: A long winding ridge of sand and gravel left by a stream under a glacier.

ex.en: The road follows the top of an esker.
ex.zh: 公路沿着蛇形丘的顶部延伸。

senses.en: A bowl-shaped hollow carved by a glacier on a mountain.

ex.en: A small lake fills the cirque.
ex.zh: 一个小湖填满了冰斗。

senses.en: A long narrow inlet of the sea between high cliffs.

ex.en: Norway is famous for its fjords.
ex.zh: 挪威以峡湾闻名。

senses.en: A deep crack in a glacier.

ex.en: The climber fell into a crevasse.
ex.zh: 登山者掉进了冰隙。

senses.en: Having a pleasant musical sound

ex.en: A melodious whistle drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵悦耳的口哨声从敞开的厨房窗户飘了进来。

ex.en: Traditional instruments produce melodious sounds that can introduce younger audiences to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统乐器奏出的优美乐声可以引导年轻听众了解自己的文化遗产。

tip: 强调声音悦耳；melodic侧重与旋律有关。

senses.en: Fine yellow soil deposited by wind.

ex.en: The Loess Plateau is covered with wind-blown dust.
ex.zh: 黄土高原覆盖着风吹来的尘土。

senses.en: A hill of sand formed by the wind.

ex.en: Sand dunes move slowly across the desert.
ex.zh: 沙丘在沙漠中缓慢移动。

senses.en: A crescent-shaped sand dune.

ex.en: Barchans form where wind blows from one direction.
ex.zh: 新月形沙丘形成于风向单一的地方。

senses.en: A flat-topped hill with steep sides.

ex.en: The mesa rises above the desert floor.
ex.zh: 台地高耸于沙漠地面之上。

senses.en: A circular current in water or air.
To move in a circular current.

ex.en: A fallen leaf spun in an eddy beside the bridge.
ex.zh: 一片落叶在桥边的漩涡中打转。

ex.en: Small eddies behind river barriers can trap floating waste and affect the movement of aquatic organisms.
ex.zh: 河流障碍物后的小漩涡会困住漂浮垃圾，并影响水生生物的移动。

tip: 可指水流或气流打旋；复数为eddies。

senses.en: An isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top, smaller than a mesa.

ex.en: Monument Valley is famous for its buttes.
ex.zh: 纪念碑谷以孤丘闻名。

senses.en: A long steep slope at the edge of a plateau.

ex.en: The road climbs the escarpment in sharp turns.
ex.zh: 公路沿着陡坡急转弯向上爬。

senses.en: A landscape of limestone with caves and sinkholes formed by dissolving water.

ex.en: Guilin's karst hills attract many visitors.
ex.zh: 桂林的喀斯特山峰吸引了许多游客。

senses.en: A hole in the ground formed when rock below dissolves and collapses.

ex.en: A sinkhole swallowed a car.
ex.zh: 一个天坑吞没了一辆车。

senses.en: A column of mineral hanging from a cave ceiling.

ex.en: Stalactites grow only a few centimeters a century.
ex.zh: 钟乳石每个世纪只生长几厘米。

senses.en: Silently showing anger or unhappiness and refusing to be friendly.

ex.en: He gave a sullen shrug and stared at the floor.
ex.zh: 他闷闷不乐地耸了耸肩，盯着地板。

ex.en: Students who feel excluded may become sullen and less willing to participate in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 感到被排斥的学生可能变得郁郁不乐，也更不愿参与课堂讨论。

col: a sullen mood｜闷闷不乐的心情
tip: 强调生气或不快时沉默、不友好的样子。

senses.en: A column of mineral rising from a cave floor.

ex.en: A stalagmite met a stalactite to form a pillar.
ex.zh: 石笋与钟乳石相连形成石柱。

senses.en: Describing a well where water rises by natural pressure.

ex.en: Artesian water flows without pumping.
ex.zh: 自流水无需抽取就能流出。

senses.en: A thick layer of ice covering a large area of land.

ex.en: The Greenland ice-sheet is melting faster.
ex.zh: 格陵兰冰盖正在加速融化。

senses.en: The process of forming mountains by folding and lifting of the earth's crust.

ex.en: The Himalayan orogeny is still going on.
ex.zh: 喜马拉雅造山运动仍在进行。

senses.en: To steal goods by force, especially during war.
Goods stolen by force, especially during war.

ex.en: The pirates plundered the ship and took its silver.
ex.zh: 海盗洗劫了那艘船，抢走了船上的白银。

ex.en: Invading armies often plunder historic sites, causing permanent damage to the cultural heritage of affected communities.
ex.zh: 入侵军队常常劫掠历史遗址，对当地社区的文化遗产造成永久损害。

tip: 常指战乱中的抢掠；也可指肆意掠夺资源。

senses.en: Relating to the formation of mountains.

ex.en: Orogenic belts form where continents collide.
ex.zh: 造山带形成于大陆碰撞处。

senses.en: The balance of the earth's crust floating on the denser mantle.

ex.en: Isostasy explains why land rises after ice melts.
ex.zh: 地壳均衡解释了冰融化后陆地为何上升。

senses.en: Relating to the balance of the crust on the mantle.

ex.en: Scandinavia is still experiencing isostatic rebound.
ex.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚仍在经历均衡回弹。

senses.en: The single supercontinent that existed about 300 million years ago.

ex.en: Pangaea began to break apart in the Jurassic.
ex.zh: 泛大陆在侏罗纪开始分裂。

senses.en: A group or set of four things.
Four chromatids formed when homologous chromosomes pair during meiosis.

ex.en: Under the microscope, we spotted a tetrad of cells.
ex.zh: 在显微镜下，我们发现了一组四个细胞。

ex.en: During meiosis, each tetrad allows genetic material to be exchanged between paired chromosomes, contributing to biological diversity.
ex.zh: 在减数分裂过程中，每个四分体使配对染色体之间能够交换遗传物质，从而促进生物多样性。

col: a tetrad of cells｜一组四个细胞
tip: 专业词；生物学四分体含四条染色单体。

senses.en: An ancient southern supercontinent.

ex.en: India was once part of Gondwana.
ex.zh: 印度曾是冈瓦纳大陆的一部分。

senses.en: A huge landmass made of several continents joined together.

ex.en: Supercontinents form and break up over hundreds of millions of years.
ex.zh: 超大陆在数亿年间聚合又分裂。

senses.en: Magnetism preserved in ancient rocks, showing past positions of the poles.

ex.en: Paleomagnetism supported the theory of continental drift.
ex.zh: 古地磁学支持了大陆漂移学说。

senses.en: The ground at the bottom of the sea.

ex.en: New seafloor forms at mid-ocean ridges.
ex.zh: 新的海底在洋中脊形成。

senses.en: To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

ex.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社为较年幼的读者推出了这部小说的删节版。

ex.en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
ex.zh: 出版社经常删节经典小说，使阅读经验有限的学生更容易读懂。

tip: 删去部分内容但保留主干，不等同于写摘要。

senses.en: Relating to the deepest parts of the ocean.

ex.en: Abyssal plains are among the flattest places on Earth.
ex.zh: 深海平原是地球上最平坦的地方之一。

senses.en: An underwater mountain that does not reach the surface.

ex.en: Fish gather around the seamount.
ex.zh: 鱼群聚集在海山周围。

senses.en: A flat-topped underwater mountain.

ex.en: A guyot was once an island worn flat by waves.
ex.zh: 平顶海山曾是被海浪削平的岛屿。

senses.en: A ring-shaped coral island surrounding a lagoon.

ex.en: Darwin explained how atolls form.
ex.zh: 达尔文解释了环礁的形成。

senses.en: to stop resisting and accept another person's demands

ex.en: After hours of arguing, we capitulated and ordered pizza.
ex.zh: 争论了几个小时后，我们终于让步，点了披萨。

ex.en: Governments should not capitulate to commercial pressure when public health and environmental protection are at stake.
ex.zh: 当公共健康和环境保护受到威胁时，政府不应向商业压力屈服。

col: capitulate to demands｜接受要求而让步
tip: 不及物动词；向某人或压力屈服用capitulate to。

senses.en: An area of shallow seawater separated from the sea by sand or coral.

ex.en: The calm lagoon is perfect for swimming.
ex.zh: 平静的潟湖很适合游泳。

senses.en: A long ridge of sand in a river or the sea.

ex.en: The boat got stuck on a sandbar.
ex.zh: 船搁浅在沙洲上。

senses.en: A sand ridge connecting an island to the mainland.

ex.en: At low tide you can walk across the tombolo.
ex.zh: 退潮时可以走过连岛沙洲。

senses.en: A narrow piece of high land sticking out into the sea.

ex.en: A lighthouse stands on the headland.
ex.zh: 一座灯塔矗立在岬角上。

senses.en: A small curved bay.

ex.en: Smugglers once hid in the cove.
ex.zh: 走私者曾躲在小海湾里。

senses.en: to formally agree to a request, demand, or proposal
to take an important official position, especially as a ruler

ex.en: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
ex.zh: 房东终于答应了我们提出的维修要求。

ex.en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
ex.zh: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。

col: accede to a request｜答应请求
tip: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。

senses.en: A narrow strip of land joining two larger areas.

ex.en: The Isthmus of Panama joins two continents.
ex.zh: 巴拿马地峡连接两个大陆。

senses.en: A very small island.

ex.en: Seabirds nest on the rocky islet.
ex.zh: 海鸟在岩石小岛上筑巢。

senses.en: A shallow area in water; a large group of fish.

ex.en: Ships avoid the dangerous shoals.
ex.zh: 船只避开危险的浅滩。

senses.en: Relating to the area between high and low tide.

ex.en: Intertidal creatures survive both air and water.
ex.zh: 潮间带生物能在空气和水中生存。

senses.en: a long journey involving many difficult or exciting experiences

ex.en: Their cycling odyssey took them across deserts and mountains.
ex.zh: 他们漫长的骑行历程带他们穿越了沙漠和群山。

ex.en: The documentary follows one family's odyssey across several continents, exploring how migration reshapes identity and belonging.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片跟随一个家庭跨越数大洲的漫长旅程，探讨迁移如何重塑身份认同与归属感。

tip: 文学色彩较强，也可比喻人生探索；复数odysseys。
